name: Adobe Inc.
summary: A high-ROIC software franchise at ~11x non-GAAP earnings, but generative-AI disruption, a CEO handover (1 Dec) and an interim CFO leave the story unproven; on the lower growth rate the Sticker is ~$189 (~$230 at 10%), below the $264 price.

name: BellRing Brands, Inc.
summary: A branded protein-shake business with ROIC above 40% that has fallen 76% as margins collapsed and net debt reached ~3.8x guided EBITDA; the screen's prices use pre-squeeze cash flow, so wait for Q4 and the new CEO's FY27 plan.

name: Deckers Outdoor Corporation
summary: Debt-free brand company (HOKA, UGG) with 40% ROIC, but the sales guide was just cut to ~4% growth and tariff refunds flatter EPS; a 6-8% growth Sticker is $37-60, so wait for a lower price or proof of the brands' staying power.

name: Futu Holdings Ltd
summary: A fast-growing online broker earning ~$13 per ADS on its latest quarter's run-rate, down 51% from its high on a proposed Chinese regulatory penalty; the business looks wonderful but the China rule-maker, the unfinished penalty and a peak-cycle quarter keep me on the sidelines until the price is near $85.

name: Intuit Inc.
summary: Cash-rich software franchise down 50% on AI-disruption fear, but the screen's 15% windage is too high and the price is still above a 10%-growth Sticker; the open question is whether TurboTax's moat has changed.

name: Kinsale Capital Group, Inc.
summary: An exceptional specialty insurer (Q3 combined ratio 75.4%, ROIC 23%), but premiums are shrinking and the price is well above every earnings-based value (~$155–$285); wait for a lower price.

name: lululemon athletica inc.
summary: A high-ROIC brand with net cash and a new CEO, but US sales are shrinking, street EPS falls again next year and TTM EPS is flattered by a tariff refund; wait for $90 or proof that the product fix works.

name: Progressive Corporation
summary: A best-in-class auto insurer, but TTM earnings sit near the top of the cycle (combined ratio ~87.5 against a 96 target), so the screen's 15% windage Sticker of $362 is not real; wait for a normalised-earnings price.

name: The Trade Desk, Inc.
summary: A high-margin ad-buying platform with $1.1B+ net cash, but revenue growth has stalled (Q3 guided down ~12%), stock pay of ~$490M a year erases much of the screen's cash flow, and it is unclear whether the loss of ad spend to Amazon is an event or a changed story; wait for a price near $8.50 or proof that revenue stabilises.

name: Super Micro Computer, Inc.
summary: AI-server assembler with thin, swinging margins, deeply negative cash flow funded by about $8.7B of debt, and open integrity questions (ineffective controls, CFO exit, co-founder indictment); price is at the screen's MOS but the screen's quality tests fail.

name: OppFi Inc.
summary: A high-yield consumer lender whose screen numbers (FCF, Payback, Ten Cap) are not real owner earnings; guidance was cut, originations fell and credit is tightening, so the screen's $29 Sticker cannot be trusted.

name: Qfin Holdings, Inc.
summary: A China loan-facilitation platform at ~3x annualised earnings, but volume, revenue and profit are collapsing under regulation and a liquidity shock; the story has changed and China political risk is a checklist item.
